def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [('logp_with_result', logp_with_result), ('logp_call_only', logp_call_only), ('logp_no_call', logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Check shapes match
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted losses: - sum(log_prob * weight) over future tokens
    L_plus_loss = -np.sum(logp_with_result * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    L_empty_loss = -np.sum(logp_no_call * normalized_weights, axis=1)
    L_call_only_loss = -np.sum(logp_call_only * normalized_weights, axis=1)

    # Compute counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty_loss, L_call_only_loss)

    # Compute margin and keep mask
    margin = L_minus - L_plus_loss
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
